name: mirage
text: Checked. Tennis is switched on in every live setting (live bids, auto-bet, the tail lane) and the code prices it, so no rule is blocking it. Two real gaps: (1) at 1:20am ET none of the engine's live feeds had any game in play (SharpAPI, SX Bet and BoltOdds all showed 0 live), so I can't see a tennis match go through the lane until daytime tennis is on; (2) the score-driven tennis model was never connected, because I stopped the day-long tennis score recording at 4am to save credits (5 per empty connection) and no real tennis frames were captured. Next: during live ATP/WTA play I trace one match through the lane to find where it drops, then connect the tennis model in paper mode first. Written to TASKS.md as CH56.
